purpose: Keep SEIS AI, sub-agent, MCP, and five-year plan wording aligned with supervised, plan-only, public-safe truth boundaries.
truthBoundary: This policy scans wording only. It does not train models, download weights, run inference, call providers, execute SSH, provision cloud/GPU resources, mutate GitHub, deploy infrastructure, or approve autonomous background agents.

disallowedPatterns.label: autonomous assistance theme
disallowedPatterns.pattern: Sustainable autonomous assistance and research readiness

disallowedPatterns.label: lane execution plan wording
disallowedPatterns.pattern: Create a scoped .* execution plan from SEIS repo evidence

disallowedPatterns.label: approved cloud runtime class wording
disallowedPatterns.pattern: Approved distributed|approved distributed, multi-accelerator, or cloud research runtime|Approved cloud or multi-device research runtime

disallowedPatterns.label: frontier cluster runtime wording
disallowedPatterns.pattern: [Ff]rontier-scale distributed research cluster|frontier-scale distributed research runtime

requiredPhrases.phrase: Sustainable supervised assistance and research readiness
requiredPhrases.message: five-year plan must use supervised assistance wording

requiredPhrases.phrase: implementation plan from SEIS repo evidence
requiredPhrases.message: MCP server lane plan description must use implementation-plan wording

requiredPhrases.phrase: implementation plan from SEIS repo evidence
requiredPhrases.message: agent tool schema lane plan description must use implementation-plan wording
MCP plan-view resource description must use browser/demo evidence wording
model scaling docs must describe cloud-scale frontier work as a future research class, not live runtime

requiredPhrases.message: model scaling profile must describe cloud-scale frontier work as a future research class, not live runtime

model scaling profile must describe 512B+ frontier work as a future research class, not a live cluster

nextSafeActions: Keep this policy narrow until broader documentation surfaces have reviewed allowlists.
Add new disallowed phrases only when they protect public-safe truth boundaries without blocking legitimate technical terms.
Keep real runtime, AGI, training, SSH, cloud, and credential claims blocked unless evidence exists and a human approves the scope.
